import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, year, sum as spark_sum, coalesce, lit, max as spark_max
from pyspark.sql.types import DoubleType

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

rent_roll_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/rent_roll/"
opex_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/opex/"
worldbank_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/economic/worldbank/"
output_path = f"s3://{bucket}/curated/noi_features/"

# Read processed parquet datasets
rent_roll_df = spark.read.parquet(rent_roll_path)
opex_df = spark.read.parquet(opex_path)
worldbank_df = spark.read.parquet(worldbank_path)

# Aggregate rent
rent_agg = (
    rent_roll_df
    .groupBy("property_id", "month")
    .agg(
        spark_sum(col("rent_income")).alias("total_rent_income")
    )
)

# Aggregate opex
opex_agg = (
    opex_df
    .groupBy("property_id", "month")
    .agg(
        spark_sum(col("operating_expense")).alias("total_opex")
    )
)

# Join rent + opex
noi_df = (
    rent_agg.alias("r")
    .join(
        opex_agg.alias("o"),
        on=[
            col("r.property_id") == col("o.property_id"),
            col("r.month") == col("o.month")
        ],
        how="left"
    )
    .select(
        col("r.property_id").alias("property_id"),
        col("r.month").alias("month"),
        col("r.total_rent_income").alias("total_rent_income"),
        coalesce(col("o.total_opex"), lit(0.0)).alias("total_opex")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "noi",
        col("total_rent_income") - col("total_opex")
    )
)

# Keep only United States inflation
inflation_us = (
    worldbank_df
    .filter(col("country_name") == "United States")
    .select(
        col("year").alias("inflation_year"),
        col("inflation_value").cast(DoubleType()).alias("inflation_rate")
    )
)

# Get latest available inflation year
latest_year = inflation_us.agg(spark_max("inflation_year").alias("max_year")).collect()[0]["max_year"]

# Get latest available inflation value
latest_inflation_rate = (
    inflation_us
    .filter(col("inflation_year") == lit(latest_year))
    .select("inflation_rate")
    .collect()[0]["inflation_rate"]
)

# Exact join first
final_df = (
    noi_df.alias("n")
    .join(
        inflation_us.alias("i"),
        year(col("n.month")) == col("i.inflation_year"),
        how="left"
    )
    .select(
        col("n.property_id"),
        col("n.month"),
        col("n.total_rent_income"),
        col("n.total_opex"),
        col("n.noi"),
        coalesce(col("i.inflation_rate"), lit(latest_inflation_rate)).alias("inflation_rate")
    )
)

# Write curated parquet
final_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(output_path)

job.commit()
